[=Regression Examples=]

This page mirrors the executable regression sources under [.txt|../SPO_CS/Regression.Tests/.].
Use it to browse real `.SPO` inputs and their `.result.SPO` oracles by topic.
For current pass/fail state, use [<../doc_ai/40_verification/41_tests_and_artifacts.wiki|41_tests_and_artifacts.wiki>] instead.

[=Browsing Rules=]

- each case is shown as source plus expected-result oracle
- sibling `.ILT` files stay beside the source in [.txt|../SPO_CS/Regression.Tests/.] and are intentionally not duplicated here
- helper files such as [.txt|_*.SPO.], expected-failure artifacts such as [.txt|*.SPO_Fail.], and generated drift files such as [.txt|*.ILT.new.] are intentionally excluded
